## Activity

During August 2019, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 36 captures as part of routine screening activity. The sessions were delivered as planned, with routine leave managed within the service. Activity was recorded for the month and no disruption to the planned programme was noted.

The completed captures provide the basis for the image-quality review and subsequent grading outcomes reported below. The results reflect the activity undertaken at the site during August 2019.

## Image quality

Of the 36 captures, 2 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.6. The ungradable images could not be used for grading and have been recorded separately from the images that produced a grading outcome.

Image-quality performance should continue to be monitored through routine review of capture practice and feedback to the clinic team where appropriate.

## Grading

Grading identified 5 referable results from the completed activity. These results were recorded for appropriate follow-up in line with the screening process.

The median lag between capture and grading was 1. This indicates that grading was generally completed promptly during the reporting month. The activity, image-quality findings and grading results should be considered together when reviewing the service provided by West Gate Eye Clinic.
